module.name: BNK Service Proxy CRDs
module.description: Installs Service Proxy Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) required for BNK Gateway API and legacy SPK controller mode.

required.reason: Provides registry authentication and CRD version information

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

required.name: crd_service_proxy_version
required.description: Version of service proxy CRDs to install

required.name: far_setup_complete
required.description: Dependency flag ensuring FAR setup is complete

key_outputs.name: crds_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating service proxy CRDs are installed
